title: India General Knowledge
description: Discover India's constitution, freedom struggle, national emblems, heritage sites, and major achievements.
seoTitle: India General Knowledge Quiz – Indian History & Heritage | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Test your India GK with 10 questions on the Constitution, national symbols, ISRO achievements, and history.

questions.question: Who was the chief architect and chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar served as the chairman of the Drafting Committee and is revered as the Father of the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: What is the national aquatic animal of India?
questions.explanation: The Ganges River Dolphin (Platanista gangetica) was declared the National Aquatic Animal of India in 2009.

questions.question: In what year did India officially gain independence from British rule?
questions.explanation: India attained independence at midnight on August 15, 1947, ending nearly two centuries of British rule.

questions.question: Which historic monument in Agra was commissioned by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal?
questions.explanation: The Taj Mahal, an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river, was commissioned in 1632.

questions.question: What is the national motto of India inscribed at the base of the Lion Capital of Ashoka?
questions.explanation: 'Satyameva Jayate' (Truth Alone Triumphs), taken from the Mundaka Upanishad, is India's national motto.

questions.question: Which Indian state has the longest coastline on the mainland?
questions.explanation: Gujarat boasts the longest coastline among Indian mainland states, extending approximately 1,600 kilometers along the Arabian Sea.

questions.question: Who was the first President of the Republic of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President of India from 1950 to 1962.

questions.question: Which space agency achieved a historic soft landing near the lunar south pole with Chandrayaan-3 in 2023?
questions.explanation: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) successfully landed the Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023.

questions.question: What is the national song of India, composed by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee?
questions.explanation: 'Vande Mataram' was composed in Sanskrit by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in his 1882 novel Anandamath.

questions.question: Which festival is famously celebrated across India with colors, water, and celebration of spring?
questions.explanation: Holi, known as the Festival of Colors, celebrates the arrival of spring, love, and the victory of good over evil.
